summary: K-Tech Solutions Company Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting a change of independent auditor: it dismissed Audit Alliance LLP and appointed Privatco CPA Limited, effective May 11, 2026. The change was approved by the audit committee, was not due to any disagreement on accounting principles or practices, and the prior audit reports were unqualified. Material weaknesses related to U.S. GAAP staffing had been disclosed in a prior filing. No special-situation transaction, activist campaign, or corporate action is present; this is a routine auditor change disclosure filed by a foreign private issuer.
